description:
Functional scope: add trusted canonical connector resource key to BO enable/disable execution and archive event options; preserve whole-operation scopes and nested callback propagation. Update docs/architecture.md and affected service guides to describe dispatch options and internal direct-entry guards.
Action reuse: extend existing ChannelsLive connector_command/event construction; reuse existing NodeRouter dispatch coordination and Engine Actions/ConnectorLifecycle implementation. No new operation/Action/tool. Same actor, confidential flags, request shapes and outputs; no changes to permission checks.
Tests before implementation: add deterministic outer dispatch regression proving hold across multiple inner calls/local state transition; retain existing connector startup/disable/archive races and run LiveView enable/disable/archive tests. New public API absence check in preceding step.
Branches: execution versus confirmation context; enable/disable/archive; saved/direct startup, stale snapshots, caller death and async/remote holds. Mocking: real boundaries and existing external adapter fakes; no new global state.
Documentation: authoritative architecture coordination section then Engine/Channels summaries. Read documentation owner before edits.
Validation: mix q, focused NodeRouter/lifecycle/startup/LiveView suites, final mix precommit under workflow lifecycle. Coverage target handoff only after human review; no speculative coverage churn.
Rollback: reject lost direct-entry lock protection, changed timeout/async semantics, or assertion weakening. E2E unnecessary for this behavior-preserving refactor; no UX/markup change.

comments.text: Validation exposed a previously unused process boundary: Jido.Exec.run/3 runs enable/disable Actions in supervised timeout workers (deps/jido_action/lib/jido_action/exec.ex execute_action_with_timeout). An outer dispatch holds coordination in the parent, but the worker otherwise generates a new requester and contends with it. Fix within the existing confidential ConnectorCommand boundary: pass opaque router scopes in trusted internal Action context (never event opts/payload), and independently acquire them around execution. Preserve Jido validation, default timeout, actor revalidation and existing domain guards. This is required scope propagation, not a timeout/async redesign. Baseline BO failures reproduced with the current change; existing assertions remain untouched. The new real disable test will cover this supervised execution path.

title: [zaq-nuz] Coordinate outer BO lifecycle dispatches and validate integration
